answer: Your records show two active medicines: atorvastatin 20 mg, one tablet by mouth once a day, for cholesterol; and Jardiance 10 mg, one tablet by mouth once a day in the morning, for diabetes. Your records also show metformin 500 mg, which ended in April 2024, so it is not a current medicine. No other medicines are recorded since February 2025. Your records were last updated in October 2026, so if you have changed anything since then, check with your doctor or pharmacy.
